description: Walk a shop's concierge one turn at a time and get a real quote. Omit `walk` to start (you get the first question and a walk id); pass `walk` + `answer` for each turn. The shop mails the quote at the end, so answer the email question with an address the person you are shopping for actually reads. Deterministic: no model on our side, and the whole conversation is sealed as a receipt the shop owner sees.

answer.description: your answer to the question the last call asked

walk.description: the walk id from a previous call — omit to start a new conversation

name: concierge_walk
title: Get a quote
